notes.subject: בצנות
notes.rationale: צנות: 'menontwana' (dikuku tse bopang dinama) kgahlanong le 'dishilde' kapa 'dintho tse hlaba' — kgetho e tsejwa hara bafetoledi.

notes.subject: בסירות דוגה
notes.rationale: 'dinepe tsa tlhapi' (fishhooks) kgahlanong le 'dikuku tsa fish' (pots, KJV 'fishhooks' vs 'boiling pots') — סירות e ka bolela nepa kapa sekepe.

notes.subject: ho lona
notes.rationale: Tlhahlobo e tobile ho basadi ba Shomrone ka boona ('lona', 'ba lona' ka bongatsa ba basadi).

notes.subject: bosalela bo se nang letho
notes.rationale: ואחריתכן e bolela 'bofelo ba lona' kapa 'lokaseho ea lona' — peo ya morao, eseng feela tlokotloko.

translation: Adonai Yahwe o ikannetse ka bohalaleli ba hae: hobane bonang, matsatsi a tla ho lona, mme ba tla lo ntsha ka menontwana, mme bosalela bo se nang letho ba lona ka dinepe tsa tlhapi.

tokens.gloss: mme bosalela bo se nang letho ba lona
